admin_audit_log_insert_tenant_investors.name: admin_audit_log_insert_tenant_investors
admin_audit_log_insert_tenant_investors.withCheck: coalesce(current_setting('app.crediai_role', true), '') = 'TENANT_USER' and "admin_audit_log"."tenant_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '') and "admin_audit_log"."entity" in ('investor', 'investment', 'investment_document', 'investment_contract', 'investment_contractor')

admin_audit_log_insert_tenant_finance.name: admin_audit_log_insert_tenant_finance
admin_audit_log_insert_tenant_finance.withCheck: coalesce(current_setting('app.crediai_role', true), '') = 'TENANT_USER' and "admin_audit_log"."tenant_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '') and "admin_audit_log"."entity" in ('capital_movement', 'wallet')

admin_audit_log_insert_tenant_investor_r.name: admin_audit_log_insert_tenant_investor_records
admin_audit_log_insert_tenant_investor_r.withCheck: coalesce(current_setting('app.crediai_role', true), '') = 'TENANT_USER' and "admin_audit_log"."tenant_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '') and "admin_audit_log"."entity" in ('investor_bank_account', 'investor_document')

capital_movement_category_matches_kind.name: capital_movement_category_matches_kind
capital_movement_category_matches_kind.value:
("capital_movement"."category" is null and "capital_movement"."kind"::text <> 'OTHER_INCOME')
    or ("capital_movement"."kind"::text = 'CONTRIBUTION' and "capital_movement"."category" in ('CAPITAL_CONTRIBUTION', 'INVESTOR_CONTRIBUTION'))
    or ("capital_movement"."kind"::text = 'OTHER_INCOME' and "capital_movement"."category" = 'OTHER_INCOME')
    or ("capital_movement"."kind"::text = 'WITHDRAWAL' and "capital_movement"."category" in ('SALARY_WITHDRAWAL', 'PARTNER_WITHDRAWAL', 'OPERATING_EXPENSE', 'TAXES_AND_FEES', 'OTHER_OUTFLOW', 'INVESTOR_YIELD_PAYMENT', 'INVESTOR_PRINCIPAL_RETURN'))

capital_movement_finance_fields.name: capital_movement_finance_fields
capital_movement_finance_fields.value: "capital_movement"."source" <> 'FINANCE' or ("capital_movement"."category" is not null and length(trim(coalesce("capital_movement"."description", ''))) > 0 and "capital_movement"."idempotency_key" is not null)

capital_movement_investor_fields.name: capital_movement_investor_fields
capital_movement_investor_fields.value:
("capital_movement"."source" = 'INVESTOR') = (coalesce("capital_movement"."category", '') in ('INVESTOR_CONTRIBUTION', 'INVESTOR_YIELD_PAYMENT', 'INVESTOR_PRINCIPAL_RETURN'))
    and ("capital_movement"."source" <> 'INVESTOR' or (length(trim(coalesce("capital_movement"."description", ''))) > 0 and "capital_movement"."idempotency_key" is not null))

client_pix_key_pair.name: client_pix_key_pair
client_pix_key_pair.value: ("client"."pix_key" is null) = ("client"."pix_key_type" is null) and ("client"."pix_key_type" is null or "client"."pix_key_type" in ('CPF', 'CNPJ', 'EMAIL', 'PHONE', 'RANDOM'))

investment_term_pair.name: investment_term_pair
investment_term_pair.value: ("investment"."term_count" is null) = ("investment"."term_unit" is null) and ("investment"."term_unit" is null or "investment"."term_unit" in ('DAYS', 'MONTHS', 'YEARS'))

investment_redemption_valid.name: investment_redemption_valid
investment_redemption_valid.value: ("investment"."redemption_rule" is null and "investment"."redemption_days" is null) or ("investment"."redemption_rule" = 'AT_MATURITY' and "investment"."redemption_days" is null) or ("investment"."redemption_rule" = 'D_PLUS' and "investment"."redemption_days" between 1 and 3650)

investor_bank_account_digits_valid.name: investor_bank_account_digits_valid
investor_bank_account_digits_valid.value: ("investor_bank_account"."branch_digit" is null or "investor_bank_account"."branch_digit" ~ '^[0-9X]$') and ("investor_bank_account"."account_digit" is null or "investor_bank_account"."account_digit" ~ '^[0-9X]$')

investor_bank_account_pix_pair.name: investor_bank_account_pix_pair
investor_bank_account_pix_pair.value: ("investor_bank_account"."pix_key" is null) = ("investor_bank_account"."pix_key_type" is null) and ("investor_bank_account"."pix_key_type" is null or "investor_bank_account"."pix_key_type" in ('CPF', 'CNPJ', 'EMAIL', 'PHONE', 'RANDOM'))

investor_bank_account_has_destination.name: investor_bank_account_has_destination
investor_bank_account_has_destination.value: ("investor_bank_account"."branch" is not null and "investor_bank_account"."account" is not null and ("investor_bank_account"."bank_code" is not null or "investor_bank_account"."bank_name" is not null)) or "investor_bank_account"."pix_key" is not null

investor_person_type_document.name: investor_person_type_document
investor_person_type_document.value: "investor"."person_type" is null or "investor"."document" is null or ("investor"."person_type" = 'PF' and length("investor"."document") = 11) or ("investor"."person_type" = 'PJ' and length("investor"."document") = 14)

investor_pix_key_pair.name: investor_pix_key_pair
investor_pix_key_pair.value: ("investor"."pix_key" is null) = ("investor"."pix_key_type" is null) and ("investor"."pix_key_type" is null or "investor"."pix_key_type" in ('CPF', 'CNPJ', 'EMAIL', 'PHONE', 'RANDOM'))

loan_operation_renegotiated_consistent.name: loan_operation_renegotiated_consistent
loan_operation_renegotiated_consistent.value: ("loan_operation"."status"::text = 'RENEGOTIATED') = ("loan_operation"."renegotiated_into_id" is not null and "loan_operation"."renegotiated_on" is not null and "loan_operation"."renegotiated_at" is not null and "loan_operation"."renegotiated_principal_cents" >= 0 and "loan_operation"."renegotiated_interest_cents" >= 0)

loan_operation_modality_valid.name: loan_operation_modality_valid
loan_operation_modality_valid.value:
("loan_operation"."modality" = 'SINGLE' and "loan_operation"."frequency" in ('MONTHLY', 'BIWEEKLY') and "loan_operation"."installment_count" is null and "loan_operation"."installment_cents" is null)
    or ("loan_operation"."modality" = 'SINGLE' and "loan_operation"."frequency" = 'DAILY' and "loan_operation"."installment_count" >= 1 and "loan_operation"."installment_cents" > 0 and "loan_operation"."first_due_date" is not null
      and "loan_operation"."total_cents" >= "loan_operation"."installment_count" * "loan_operation"."installment_cents" and "loan_operation"."total_cents" < "loan_operation"."installment_count" * "loan_operation"."installment_cents" + "loan_operation"."installment_count")
    or ("loan_operation"."modality" = 'INSTALLMENT' and "loan_operation"."frequency" in ('MONTHLY', 'BIWEEKLY') and "loan_operation"."installment_count" >= 1 and "loan_operation"."installment_cents" > 0 and "loan_operation"."first_due_date" is not null
      and "loan_operation"."total_cents" >= "loan_operation"."installment_count" * "loan_operation"."installment_cents")
